info.title: AI Gateway integration API
info.description:
The AI Gateway portal lets LINAGORA employees request API keys for the gateway's models. This API lets an **integration** (a third-party application declared by a portal admin, such as Team Manager) act **for one employee at a time**, on that employee's own requests and keys only. It never grants the rights of an admin or of a team manager: requests are still examined and approved in the portal, by the same people, with the same rules, emails and audit trail.

## Integration token

Every call carries `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, a JWT **signed by the integration** with the private key matching a public key registered for it in the portal:

- header: `alg` is the algorithm of the registered key (`EdDSA` with an Ed25519 key, or `RS256`), `kid` the identifier of that key;
- `iss`: the integration identifier, as registered in the portal;
- `aud`: `ai-gateway`;
- `sub`: the employee's LDAP uid, **exactly** the `sub` that LemonLDAP::NG gives to the portal;
- `email` and `name`: the employee's address and display name;
- `iat` and `exp`: `exp` at most 300 seconds after `iat`; a 30-second clock tolerance applies.

Any other token is refused with `401 jeton_invalide`. Sign a fresh token for each call, or reuse one within its short validity.

## Checks, in order

1. The integration is known and active, otherwise `503 integration_inactive`.
2. The caller's IP address belongs to the integration's addresses or CIDR ranges, otherwise `403 adresse_non_autorisee`.
3. The integration's request limit (set by the admin, 120 requests per minute by default) is not exceeded, otherwise `429 trop_de_requetes`.
4. The route belongs to the integration's **scopes** (`lecture`, `demandes`, `cles`, see `x-scope`), otherwise `403 hors_perimetre`.
5. On an employee's first access, the portal registers them with the gateway. An unknown uid whose email already belongs to another uid is refused with `409 identite_incoherente`.

## Errors, languages, caching

Errors share one shape: a stable `code`, a `message` translated according to `Accept-Language` (`fr` by default, `en`), and `details`. An unknown route answers `404 introuvable`; an unexpected failure answers `500 erreur_interne`. Labels (levels, statuses) follow the same language. Every response carries `Cache-Control: no-store`. A key value is returned only once, by a pickup or a replacement: never log or store responses that contain one. Request bodies are limited to 16 KiB.

## Limits

Besides the integration's request limit, an employee may pick up or replace at most 5 keys per 10 minutes (`429 trop_de_generations`). A `429` response carries `Retry-After`.

## Audit and versioning

Every action made through this API is recorded in the portal's audit log with the integration as its channel. The key routes (scope `cles`) are opened to an integration by a portal admin, once it has passed its acceptance tests. An incompatible change will be published under `/api/v2`.

get.description: The OpenAPI document of the deployed version, for any authenticated integration.
Teams the employee belongs to, for which they may request a key.

get.summary: Teams the employee may ask to join
get.description: Teams the employee is not a member of and has no pending access request for.

200.description: Teams open to an access request.

get.description: Confidentiality levels with their accepted classifications and the models that accept each level, the exact commitment text the employee must accept before a key request, and the visible models.

200.description: The catalog, in the requested language.

get.description: Key requests and team access requests of the employee, most recent first, with their status and the examiner's comment.
Approved keys waiting to be picked up, then issued keys (active first), with their spend and budget read live from the gateway. Never the key value.

post.description: Creates a team access request, examined in the portal by a manager of the team or an admin.

Creates a key request, examined in the portal. The same checks as in the portal apply (team membership, models of the team, level accepted by every model, visible models); the commitment must be accepted. With `renewsRequestId`, the request renews a key of the employee.

201.description: The request was created and sent for examination.

put.description: Completes a key request that the examiner sent back to the employee (status `NEEDS_COMPLETION`); it goes back to examination.

post.description: Cancels a key request or a team access request that has not been approved yet.

Generates the key of an approved request and returns its value **once**. If the response is lost, replace the key. At most 5 pickups or replacements per employee per 10 minutes. The employee receives an email naming the integration.
Issues a new key with the same parameters, expiry and spend, returned **once**; the old key is deleted. Refused for an expired or blocked key. The employee receives an email naming the integration.
Revokes one of the employee's own keys; the gateway refuses it within seconds. The employee receives an email naming the integration.

get.description: The parameters of a key of the employee, to prefill its renewal request (`POST /key-requests` with `renewsRequestId`).

integrationToken.description: JWT signed by the integration (EdDSA Ed25519 or RS256, as registered). Required: header `kid`; claims `iss` (integration identifier), `aud` (`ai-gateway`), `sub` (LDAP uid), `email`, `name`, `iat`, `exp` (at most 300 seconds after `iat`).

AcceptLanguage.name: Accept-Language
AcceptLanguage.description: Language of messages and labels: `fr` (default) or `en`.

RequestId.name: id
RequestId.description: Identifier of the request (a key is identified by the request it comes from).

BadRequest.description: Invalid input (`saisie_invalide`), commitment not accepted (`engagement_requis`), request refused by the access policy (`controles_en_echec`, with the failed checks in `details.failedChecks`) or incomplete key parameters (`parametre_manquant`).

Unauthorized.description: Missing, forged, expired or otherwise invalid integration token (`jeton_invalide`, with `details.reason`, and `details.claim` for a missing or invalid claim).

Forbidden.description: Route outside the integration's scopes (`hors_perimetre`, with the required scope in `details.scope`), caller address not allowed (`adresse_non_autorisee`), employee not a member of the team (`non_membre`) or action refused (`interdit`).

NotFound.description: Unknown resource or route, or one that belongs to another employee (`introuvable`, with `details.object`).

Conflict.description: Incompatible status or concurrent change (`transition_interdite`, with `details.case`), pending request (`demande_en_cours`, with `details.team`), already a member (`deja_membre`, with `details.team`) or inconsistent identity (`identite_incoherente`).

TooManyRequests.description: Integration request limit (`trop_de_requetes`) or employee key generation limit (`trop_de_generations`) exceeded.

BadGateway.description: The gateway is unavailable (`passerelle_indisponible`); nothing was changed.

details.description: Code-specific details, with English keys and stable identifiers as values, for instance `reason`, `claim`, `scope`, `object`, `case`, `team`, `fields` or `failedChecks`.

error.message: Engagez-vous à ne pas soumettre de données d'un niveau supérieur à celui déclaré.

ErrorCode.description: Stable error code; the list may grow within `/api/v1`.

offending.description: Elements at fault, for instance the models that do not accept the level.

DataLevel.description: Confidentiality level: N1 Public, N2 Internal, N3 Confidential, EXP Experimental (beta).

ValidityDays.description: Validity of the key once picked up, in days; 0: the key never expires.

name.description: Translated name, for instance « N2 Interne ».

models.description: Visible models that accept this level (a model accepts every level up to its maximal level; the Experimental level only accepts Experimental models).

modelName.description: Name to use in a key request and when calling the gateway.

commitment.description: Exact commitment text, to display as is before sending a key request.

anyOf.description: After this date the request expires.

spend.description: Spend in euros over the current budget period.

anyOf.description: Budget in euros; null: no budget.

blocked.description: Blocked by a manager or an admin.

requestId.description: Identifies the key in this API.

commitment.description: The employee accepted the commitment text of `GET /catalog`.
The employee accepted the commitment text of `GET /catalog`.

anyOf.description: Renewal: the request of the employee's key to renew (issued, expired or revoked).

key.description: The key value, returned once: never log or store it.
